GHA.note: A fibre network for 951 public institutions only; no rural programme or rural and urban figures.
Digital skills named only as a focus area of the policy; no programme stated.

facts.fact: Communications and Digitalisation Minister Ursula Owusu-Ekuful launched Ghana's Digital Economy Policy and Strategy at a media briefing in Accra on 28 November 2024, with five focus areas including entrepreneurship, digital skills and digital government.

GHA.note: An e-Government network linking 951 institutions is connectivity, not services people can complete online.
